newsitem.title: USA: Motorola signs $200 million contract in China.
newsitem.headline: Motorola signs $200 million contract in China.

text.p: Motorola Inc. said Wednesday its Asia Pacific Cellular Infrastructure Group signed a $200 million contract to supply cellular equipment and services in China.
Under the agreement, Motorola APCIG will provide Total Access Communications System equipment and services to Eastern Communications Co. Ltd. of China and Zhejiang Technical Import & Export Corp.
The contract will enable Eastern Communications to expand its manufacturing and distribution of Motorola's TACS cellular infrastructure equipment, Motorola said.
"This is the seventh TACS contract between our three companies," Tom Hinton, vice president and assistant general manager of Motorola APCIG.
Motorola's stock was up 37.5 cents at $59 on the New York Stock Exchange.
